visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A muscular man in a black tank top and wrist wraps is lying on a gym bench, performing a bench press with a barbell loaded with blue and red plates. He successfully pushes the bar up and racks it. The setting is a professional gym with dark wood-paneled walls and various weight racks. (2) The man sits up on the bench, looking bewildered and touching his chin with his hand as if thinking. Yellow Chinese subtitles appear at the bottom. The lighting is bright and even across the gym floor. (3) The camera cuts to a second man in a white t-shirt and glasses standing to the right, followed by a third man in a black and white striped shirt standing to the left. Both are looking at the main character. (4) The main character sits on the bench, gesturing with his hands and looking at his watch while talking to the other two men. They all stand around the weight bench, and the scene ends with them interacting and laughing in the well-lit gym environment.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the heavy breathing of a man and the loud metallic clank of a barbell being racked. A mid-tempo electronic beat with synthesized drums plays in the background. The man lets out a surprised vocalization. (2) A clear male voice enters, speaking Chinese with a questioning and surprised tone. The music continues with a steady pulse. (3) Two other male voices respond in a conversational, matter-of-fact tone, explaining that they were helping with the weight. The background music remains consistent in volume. (4) The conversation becomes more animated with overlapping voices and higher-pitched laughter. The sound of metal weight plates shifting is heard briefly as the track fades with the upbeat BGM.
